1.1.0: Upgrade to the 2023-04 version of the Shopify API.
1.2.0: Implemented multiselect input normalization for tax_exemptions field in CreateCustomer and UpdateCustomer components.
1.2.1: Added output examples to component schemas.
1.3.0: Implemented test() methods for all trigger components to support Flow Test Mode.
1.4.0: Added MakeApiCall component for performing arbitrary authorized API calls to the Shopify API.
2.0.0: BREAKING: Switched authentication from OAuth 2.0 to Admin API access token (apiKey). Each merchant now creates a custom app in their own Shopify admin (Settings → Apps and sales channels → Develop apps) and provides the store address and Admin API access token (shpat_...). This enables multi-tenant use without Shopify App Store review. Existing users must reconnect their account.
Removed App Store-only GDPR mandatory webhooks (customers/data_request, customers/redact, shop/redact) and the OAuth install route, which are not applicable to custom apps.
Removed leftover OAuth scope declarations from component auth blocks (engine could not match apiKey accounts against scope filters — 'Access token not found').
Create Order: omit the customer object when no customer id or customer fields are provided (Shopify rejects an empty customer).
2.1.0: Added 11 new trigger components matching common e-commerce automations: New Paid Order (orders/paid), New Refund (refunds/create), New Fulfillment / Updated Fulfillment (fulfillments/*), New Checkout / Updated Checkout (checkouts/*), Abandoned Cart (polls abandoned checkouts), New Draft Order / Updated Draft Order (draft_orders/*), Inventory Level Updated (inventory_levels/update), and Return Tracking (returns/update; requires Shopify API 2023-10+ and read_returns scope).
New modules: checkouts, draftorders, inventory, returns.
